evals.prompt: Verify tutor's committed eval fixtures end to end, offline: parse the realism Export, confirm the synthetic Collections cover its gaps, confirm the fixture Briefs and Decks are well-formed with their planted flaws registered, and confirm the pinned Scryfall snapshot and the fixture Oracle derived from it cover exactly the fixture cards.
evals.expected_output: A red/green report over the fixture tree with every mechanical expectation green, proving the harness — case loading, fixture resolution, fixed-predicate grading, report emission — end to end without any network call.
expectations: The realism fixture collections/real-collection.csv parses header-keyed as CSV with exactly 577 data rows.
A synthetic Collection row carries the etched Foil value the real Export lacks.
Synthetic Collection rows carry non-English Language codes the real Export lacks, including the disputed zhs.
A synthetic Collection row carries a promo collector number (letter-suffixed or starred) the real Export lacks.
Per-Format shaped pool Collections cover Kitchen 20 (Uncharted Haven beside mono-white candidates) and Standard (playset quantities), parsing with the full ManaBox header.
Fixture Briefs parse as flat key: value Blocks with the required format: line and only canonical Brief keys.
Fixture Decks parse as ManaBox-importable Deck Blocks: title comment, Board headers, quantity lines with set-and-number pins on nonbasics.
Some fixture Decks carry planted flaws for Review evals, each registered in the manifest and naming cards present in its Deck (or absent from every Collection for availability flaws).
The pinned Scryfall snapshot covers every card the fixtures reference and nothing else, with its capture metadata on line one.
The fixture Oracle scryfall/oracle.jsonl is byte-identical to a fresh offline derivation from the pinned snapshot.

Every Oracle line is name-keyed with mana value, colors, color identity, type line, oracle text, the four sanctioned legalities, and the game_changer flag — no UUIDs, tokens excluded, basics included, multi-faced names flattened with //.
The Oracle's first line records generated_at and the source Export's newest Added watermark.
Evals never touch the network: a tripwire scan finds the literal live Scryfall API host string in no eval or fixture file except the deliberate refresh script and the snapshot's provenance metadata.

evals.prompt: Generate the Oracle for a Collection home offline: run the oracle skill's build script over the realism Export with resolution pinned to the committed Scryfall snapshot, and verify the written oracle.jsonl, the tolerant-parse report, and the Name + Set code fallback — without any network call.
evals.expected_output: oracle.jsonl beside the Export — metadata line one carrying generated_at and the source Export's newest Added watermark, then one shape-exact JSON line per unique card name — plus a report counting malformed rows skipped and cards resolved, with legality data marked informational-only.
expectations: Run offline against the pinned snapshot, the oracle script writes the Oracle beside the realism Export: line one records generated_at plus the source Export's newest Added watermark, then one line per unique card name.

Every Oracle line the script writes is byte-identical to the fixture Oracle's line for the same card — the shape-exact record with four-Format legalities, the game_changer boolean, tokens excluded, basics included, multi-faced names flattened with //, and no UUIDs.
Malformed Export rows are skipped and reported with a count and examples, and a header missing the identity columns is the only hard failure.
An Export row whose Scryfall ID the snapshot no longer knows still resolves through its Name + Set code.
Run as /tutor:oracle in a Collection home, the skill's closing report surfaces the two staleness signals and marks Scryfall legality data informational-only, without implying Scryfall endorsement.

evals.prompt: I want a new Commander deck around Tatyova, Benthic Druid — simic, lands matter, steady card draw, nothing above 6 mana, and no infinite combos. My Baylen deck can be cannibalized for it. Scripted answers for the rest of the brief conversation: name it Tatyova Landfall; power 2; yes, the Export is current; keep every other deck committed.
evals.expected_output: The brief conversation fires, asks the single Export/Oracle freshness question, and ends with a Brief Block equivalent to evals/fixtures/briefs/commander-tatyova-landfall.txt — flat key: value lines, format: commander, the mechanical ask as a constraint: line and the fuzzy asks in notes:, donor: Baylen, the Haymaker recognized from the Export's deck rows, no budget key — validated by skills/brief/scripts/validate_brief.py and written to the Collection home.
expectations: The /tutor:brief command is a thin wrapper handing off to the brief skill, whose metadata.version matches the plugin manifest's pinned version.
The brief skill's description fires from natural language: it names deck-intent triggers beyond the /tutor:brief command itself.
Every fixture Brief validates against the brief skill's validator, donors recognized from its manifest-paired Export's deck rows.
The validator holds the Power ladder: a 1-5 number with trailing free text passes and an out-of-ladder number fails.
The validator holds donor grammar: donor: all passes and an unrecognized donor Deck name fails against the Export's deck rows.
No fixture Brief declares a play variant as its format:, and the Archenemy fixture expresses the variant in play variant: with the Centerpiece naming the villain.
The freshness helper surfaces the fixture Export's newest Added and both Oracle staleness signals deterministically, and degrades gracefully when the Oracle is absent.
The brief skill's text pins the grammar it must emit: all nine canonical keys, only format required, no budget key, Power defaulting to 2, one freshness question, and a closing handoff to Build.
Invoked from natural language alone — no /tutor:brief command typed — the skill fires and opens the brief conversation.
Run with the scripted answers, the conversation ends in a Brief Block equivalent to the Tatyova fixture Brief, written to the Collection home.
Mechanical asks land as constraint: lines and fuzzy asks land in notes: — each where it can be honestly enforced.
The conversation asks the Export/Oracle freshness question exactly once.
A pasted Export is always accepted and beats the file on conflict: the diff — rows added, removed, quantities changed — is reported, then the paste is worked from.

evals.prompt: Start a Build from the fixture Tatyova Brief in a Collection home: generate the declarative Suite from the Brief and the Commander Format profile before any card is picked, and show it honestly red on the empty Deck through the fixed runner.
evals.expected_output: The committed fixture Suite — snapshotted Commander targets, the quota table over the global Role vocabulary, mechanical Brief constraints under provenance comments, an empty Role-tag section — reproduced byte-identical by the generator, plus the runner's red empty-Deck report matching the committed reference: every size, mana-base-count, curve, and quota Check red, constraint-shaped Checks vacuously green, both written to the Collection home.
expectations: The Commander Format profile is first-class declarative data: deck size 100, singleton copy limit, lands, curve, and consistency check targets, per-bracket Game Changers limits 0 / 0 / 3 / unlimited / unlimited for Power 1-5, a banlist parameter, and judgment-flavored Role guidance.
Run over the fixture Tatyova Brief, the Commander profile, and the fixture Oracle, the Suite generator reproduces the committed fixture Suite byte-identical — declarative data, never code.

The fixture Suite carries every generated Check class — Legality, Availability, Mana base, Curve, Quotas over the global Role vocabulary, mechanical Brief constraints, hypergeometric Consistency — with no budget class, targets snapshotted from the profile, Brief-set values under brief: provenance comments, and an empty roles: section because no card is picked yet.

Through the unmodified runner, the empty fixture Deck reports byte-identical to the committed reference: every size, mana-base-count, curve, and quota Check red, the singleton, color identity, banlist, Game Changers, and availability Checks vacuously green, exit code red.
The /tutor:build command is a thin wrapper handing off to the build skill, whose metadata.version matches the plugin manifest's pinned version.

The build skill's text pins the front half: the Suite and its report written to the Collection home, the offer to generate an absent Oracle via /tutor:oracle when network allows, a pasted Export or Block beating the file, a refused constraint going back to the Brief, and no card picked before the Suite exists.
Run live, /tutor:build walks a Collection home from Brief to written Suite and red report, explaining vacuous green honestly.
Role tagging judgment is recorded once per card in the Suite's roles: section as Build fills the Deck, and quota Checks count those tags mechanically.
